child.label: Impulses & Coping
child.description: Questions about resisting cravings and impulses, bingeing, saying or doing things you regret, and coping with or being crushed by setbacks and problems.
child.not_for: Fear, panic, and worry (use Fear & Worry); self-esteem and what others think (use Self-Consciousness); anger, irritability, and mood swings (use Temper & Moodiness).
examples: Do you bounce back quickly from setbacks?

child.label: Self-Consciousness
child.description: Questions about self-esteem, needing approval, caring what others think, feeling judged or talked about, and handling criticism.
child.not_for: Fear of danger and general worry (use Fear & Worry); anger and mood swings (use Temper & Moodiness).
examples: Do you need other people's approval?
Do you have a low opinion of yourself?
